description: An agent skill marketplace that audits any website URL and produces a structured JSON report identifying why a brand is hard for AI assistants to discover and cite, and why on-site visitors fail to engage — with prioritized, actionable fixes.
author: brand-ai-readiness-audit contributors

skills.name: audit-orchestrator
skills.description: Entrypoint skill. Accepts a URL, invokes all six worker audit skills, merges findings into a single schema-compliant JSON report with severity counts and sequential finding IDs.

skills.name: crawl-access-audit
skills.description: Checks whether AI crawlers and search bots can access the site: robots.txt disallow rules, HTTP status codes, redirect chains, and sitemap.xml presence.

skills.name: render-readability-audit
skills.description: Detects content that is only visible after JavaScript execution by diffing raw HTTP response text against Playwright-rendered DOM text. Reports the percentage of key content hidden from raw crawlers.

skills.name: structured-data-audit
skills.description: Checks for the presence, validity, and completeness of JSON-LD schema.org markup (Organization, Product, Article, FAQPage, etc.) on a representative sample of pages.

skills.name: freshness-corroboration-audit
skills.description: Validates internal fact consistency (address, phone, hours, pricing) across multiple pages, and checks for dateModified / datePublished metadata signalling content freshness.

skills.name: entity-clarity-audit
skills.description: Checks for disambiguating identity signals: sameAs links to verified profiles, explicit legal/brand name, About page identity statements, and unique external identifiers (LinkedIn, Wikidata, Crunchbase).

skills.name: engagement-audit
skills.description: Evaluates on-site visitor engagement signals: nav clarity, broken internal links, dead-end pages, above-fold orientation cues, breadcrumbs, and search availability.
